source: Public RotationForge planner database, read-only export

skills.name: Smouldering Fire
skills.description: Applies Heat Infliction and grants Melting Flame. At 4 Melting Flame, consumes all stacks and applies Combustion instead of the normal Heat Infliction.

skills.name: Crimson Shadow
skills.description: Applies Lift. If Vulnerability is present, Rossi also performs a Heat follow-up.

skills.name: Breath of Transformation
skills.description: Triggers on Final Strike or Finisher against a target with Electric Infliction. Consumes Electric Infliction to forcibly apply Electrification.

skills.name: Free Giveaway
skills.description: Triggers when the enemy has at least 2 Cryo or Nature Infliction stacks. Adds another stack of the matching Arts Infliction.

skills.name: Full Moon Slash
skills.description: Triggers when Breach or Crush consumes Vulnerable stacks. Deals Physical DMG and recovers SP.

skills.name: Moment of Blazing Shadow
skills.description: Triggers when the enemy has Vulnerability and any Arts Infliction. Consumes all Arts Infliction stacks, applies Lift, and buffs Rossi's Crit stats.

skills.name: Flaming Cinders
skills.description: Final Strike. Absorbs Heat Infliction and converts absorbed stacks into Melting Flame.

skills.name: Seethe
skills.description: Triggers on Combustion or Corrosion.

skills.name: Arcane Staff: Gravity Field
skills.description: Applies Nature Infliction, Slow, and Arts Susceptibility. Lifted targets remain airborne while the field persists.

skills.name: Mantra of Sundering
skills.description: Consumes Electrification to create Sunderblades, channels nearby Sunderblades for Thunder Strikes, and grants Electric Amp.

skills.name: RIVER, TO ME!
skills.description: Triggers when applying Cryo Infliction or dealing Arts Burst DMG. Creates a Whirlpool.

skills.name: IMA WAVERIDAAH!
skills.description: Shoots Cryo waves that apply Cryo Infliction and can trigger Waterspouts from existing Whirlpools.

skills.name: EMP Test Site
skills.description: Triggers when a focused enemy suffers a Physical Status or Arts Infliction, then applies another stack of the same effect.

skills.name: Distributed DoS
skills.description: Summons Auxiliary Crystal. The crystal provides HP Treatment after Final Strikes and grants Arts Amp if HP is full.

skills.name: Stress Testing
skills.description: Triggers when Auxiliary Crystal uses up its HP treatments. Applies Cryo Infliction.

skills.name: Dolly Rush
skills.description: Creates Mr. Dolly healing zones. If Corrosion is present nearby, Dolly Rush can recast for free.

skills.name: Darkness Cowed
skills.description: Sweeps his lance for Physical DMG and applies Lift. After Stars Shifted, this skill becomes Bolt Rush for 20s.

skills.name: Heavens Sundered
skills.description: The charge, Cleansing Cleave and Ground Pierce deal Electric DMG. Cleansing Cleave applies 1 Electric Infliction; Ground Pierce applies Crush. A non-weak enemy can stop the charge early. Sunderization explosions are not calculated.

skills.name: Apex Prankster
skills.description: Deals Nature DMG. If the target has at least 2 Cryo or Nature Infliction stacks, applies the same Arts Infliction again.

skills.name: Dance of Rime
skills.description: Final Strike. Applies Cryo Infliction only while Hypothermic Perfusion is active.

skills.name: Esoteric Legacy of Seš'qa
skills.description: Applies Hypothermic Perfusion to the controlled operator's weapon and returns 30 SP. The next Final Strike within the duration creates Last Rite's Mirage, dealing Cryo DMG and applying Cryo Infliction.

skills.name: Turbid Avatar
skills.description: Deals 3 hits of Physical DMG, applies Knock Down and 1 Vulnerable stack. If the target had no Vulnerable stacks before the last hit, also applies Physical Susceptibility.

skills.name: Aspect of Wrath
skills.description: Triggers when the controlled operator performs a Final Strike on an enemy with Physical Susceptibility or Breach. Deals Physical DMG and grants Link.

skills.name: Heart of the Unmoving
skills.description: Deals massive Physical DMG, knocks enemies down, and pulls them closer.

skills.name: Bolt Rush
skills.description: After Stars Shifted, replaces Darkness Cowed for 20s. Deals Electric DMG and forcibly applies Electrification. Consumes all Electric Infliction, raising this Electrification’s Status Level by 1 per stack consumed. Consuming Electric Infliction also applies 1 Vulnerability stack. Sunderization and talent damage are not calculated.

skills.name: Qingbo Triplex - Trail and Mangle
skills.description: Costs 50 SP. Mi Fu unleashes a flurry of strikes that deal Physical DMG and applies 1 Vulnerability stack, with the final hit applying Crush. If that Crush consumes at least 3 Vulnerability stacks, the next Battle Skill is replaced with World Splitter.

skills.name: Really Heavy Bash
skills.description: Salvages all dropped Weapons, then consumes all Hot Edgy Naives. Deals 300% + 100% per stack (up to 3) Nature DMG and applies Nature Infliction. At 3 stacks, forcibly applies Combustion for 5s.

skills.name: Really Kwik Smash
skills.description: Requires at least 1 Weapon and a new Nature Infliction or Arts Burst hit. Throws 1 Weapon, recovers 12 SP and forcibly applies Nature Burst. Pick up the dropped Weapon explicitly or salvage it with Battle Skill.

skills.name: Salvage Weapon
skills.description: Place when the controlled operator touches one dropped Weapon. Restores 1 Weapon and grants 1 Hot Edgy Naives stack. Does nothing when no Weapon is on the battlefield.

skills.name: Counter-Assault Tactic — Attach Device
skills.description: Attaches a portable device. Recast to detonate, or apply Lift, Knock Down, Solidification or Immobilization to trigger Concentrating Fusillade.

skills.name: Counter-Assault Tactic — Detonate Device
skills.description: Detonates an attached device, deals unquantified Physical DMG, applies Vulnerable, Protection and Physical Amp. Zone values and lifetime are unknown.

skills.name: Concentrating Fusillade
skills.description: Requires a device attached before a new Lift, Knock Down, Solidification or Immobilization. Shoots down the device for Physical DMG and an enhanced buff zone. Numeric values remain unavailable.

skills.name: Thermite Tracers
skills.description: Applies Heat Infliction. If Combustion or Electrification is active, consumes it instead for extra Heat DMG.
